info.title: Troubleshooting
info.description: API service to run troubleshooting tests on devices - Access Points (APs), CX Switches, AOS-S Switches, and Gateways (GWs).

tags.name: Events
tags.description: APIs to manage and retrieve network events

get.summary: List Events
get.description: This API endpoint retrieves a list of Network Events, based on the query parameters provided. Each Event in the returned list includes details like event name, category, source type, severity, etc. The query parameters allow you to narrow down the results that meet specific criteria, ensuring you receive only the relevant data.

parameters.name: context-type
parameters.description: Type of context (SITE, ACCESS_POINT, SWITCH, GATEWAY, WIRELESS_CLIENT, WIRED_CLIENT, BRIDGE).

parameters.name: context-identifier
parameters.description: Context Identifier (site ID, device serial number or client MAC address).

parameters.name: start-at
parameters.description: Data is required starting from this timestamp, provided in RFC 3339 (and ISO 8601) format in the UTC timezone with milliseconds. The difference between *end-at* and *start-at* should be less than 30 days.

parameters.name: end-at
parameters.description: Data is required up to this timestamp, provided in RFC 3339 (and ISO 8601) format in the UTC timezone with milliseconds. The timestamp must be earlier than the current time and later than the start-at.

parameters.name: site-id
parameters.description: Site ID to filter the event details for a specific site.

parameters.name: search
parameters.description: Search events by name, serial number, host name, client MAC address or device MAC address. Full text search is not supported. Search is restricted to the metadata.

parameters.name: filter
parameters.description:
OData Version 4.0 filter string (limited functionality). Supports only 'and' conjunction ('or' and 'not' are NOT supported). Supported fields and operators are in the below given table.

| Field | Operators |
| --------- | -------- |
| `eventId` | `eq` and `in` |
| `category` |`eq` and `in` |
| `sourceType` |`eq` and `in` |

**The operators are implemented as follows:**

* `eq`: Only values exactly matching the given value are returned.

* `in`: Only values present in the given list are returned.

parameters.name: sort
parameters.description:
Sort expressions. A sort expression is a property name optionally followed by a direction indicator asc (ascending) or desc (descending).

If a direction indicator is omitted, the default direction is descending.

Supported fields are 

| Sort Field                          | Description                          |
| ----------------------------------- | ------------------------------------ |
| `timeAt`                              | The field `timeAt` denotes event timestamp. |

parameters.name: next
parameters.description: Specifies the pagination cursor for the next page of resources. Minimum value is 1.

parameters.name: limit
parameters.description: Maximum number of events to be retrieved. Allowed range is 1 to 1000.

get.summary: Get Event Extra Attributes
get.description: This API endpoint retrieves extra attributes of the event. The response includes event attributes as key-value pairs.

parameters.name: event-identifier
parameters.description: Unique identifier of the event to retrieve details for.

parameters.name: site-id
parameters.description: Site ID to filter the event details for a specific site.

parameters.name: time-at
parameters.description: Timestamp of when the event occurred, provided in RFC 3339 (and ISO 8601) format in the UTC timezone with milliseconds.

get.summary: Get Event Filters
get.description: This endpoint returns available filter options for network events, including categories, source types, and event names with their respective counts. Use this information to construct filters for the List Events API.

parameters.name: context-type
parameters.description: Type of context (SITE, ACCESS_POINT, SWITCH, GATEWAY, WIRELESS_CLIENT, WIRED_CLIENT, BRIDGE).
